widget.name: Phone Time via Holos
widget.short_description: Shows local time and country flag by phone number.
widget.description: Displays the contact's local time and country flag next to every phone number, in the lead card and the contact card.
widget.tour_description:
Shows a country flag and the contact local time next to every phone number, in the lead card and the contact card. Hover over the badge to see the country.

Getting started:
1. Install the widget.
2. Open any lead or contact with a phone number.
3. The flag and time appear automatically.

Need help? Contact soporte@holos.ec
